children: KonaTel disclosed that IM Telecom, in which it holds a 51% interest, received an FCC notice alleging violations of the Lifeline Advantage Program and has filed a response disputing the claims.
IM Telecom received an FCC Notice alleging Lifeline Advantage Program rule violations, per KonaTel's 8-K.
IM Telecom filed a response (Exhibit 99) asserting it obtained affirmative consents and proper subscriber PII.
IM Telecom argues termination of NLAD access was improper and that its monthly billing model is not subject to the Non-Usage Rule.
IM Telecom contends there was no unapproved transfer of control despite KonaTel’s 51% membership interest.
KonaTel warns the FCC action may have adverse consequences for the company, but the effects are currently undetermined.

title: KonaTel receives FCC notice to IM Telecom over Lifeline program access
